items.exampleEn: The tomato seedlings need plenty of sunlight.
items.exampleZh: 番茄幼苗需要充足的陽光。

items.exampleEn: A family of otters lives under the old bridge.
items.exampleZh: 一家水獺住在那座舊橋下面。

items.exampleEn: Some artists mix tree resin into their paint.
items.exampleZh: 有些畫家會把樹脂調進顏料裡。

items.exampleEn: The climbers reached the rocky pinnacle before noon.
items.exampleZh: 登山者在中午前登上了岩石尖峰。

items.exampleEn: Many desert animals are nocturnal to avoid the heat of the day.
items.exampleZh: 許多沙漠動物在夜間活動，以避開白天的高溫。

items.exampleEn: This morning's coffee tastes slightly acidic.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上的咖啡喝起來有點酸。

items.exampleEn: Maple sap is boiled to make something sweet for pancakes.
items.exampleZh: 楓樹的樹液經過熬煮，可以做成淋在鬆餅上的甜醬。

items.exampleEn: A narrow fissure ran down the old stone wall.
items.exampleZh: 一道細長的裂縫從老石牆上延伸下來。

items.sentenceEn: Owls are nocturnal and hunt for food at night.
items.sentenceZh: 貓頭鷹是夜行性動物，晚上出來覓食。

items.audioEn: An otter floated on its back while cracking a shell on its chest.
items.audioZh: 一隻水獺仰躺著漂在水上，在胸前敲開一個貝殼。
options: Opening a shell on its chest

items.sentenceEn: Lemon juice is acidic, so it can be used to clean metal.
items.sentenceZh: 檸檬汁是酸性的，所以可以用來清潔金屬。

items.sentenceEn: Sticky sap ran slowly from the cut branch.
items.sentenceZh: 黏黏的樹液從被砍斷的樹枝上慢慢流下來。

items.stemEn: Water slowly entered a deep ____ in the rock and froze there.
items.stemZh: 水慢慢滲進岩石的一道深縫裡，在那裡結了冰。

items.stemEn: Winning the gold medal was the ____ of her long career.
items.stemZh: 贏得金牌是她漫長職業生涯的巔峰。

items.passageEn: Every spring, volunteers plant thousands of pine seedlings along the river near our town. The soil there is slightly acidic, which suits pine trees well. A forest guide showed us how the trees produce a sticky resin when their bark is damaged; it protects them from insects. Later, near the river, we saw signs of otters. They are mostly nocturnal, so we did not see the animals themselves. The guide also pointed out a long fissure in the rocks where water runs during heavy rain. He believes the land along the river will be wooded again in twenty years.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，志工都會沿著我們鎮附近的河邊種下好幾千棵松樹苗。那裡的土壤微酸，很適合松樹生長。一位森林導覽員讓我們看樹皮受損時，樹木會分泌黏黏的樹脂，用來保護自己不受昆蟲侵害。後來在河岸邊，我們看到了水獺出沒的痕跡。牠們大多在夜間活動，所以我們沒有看到水獺本身。導覽員還指出岩石間有一道長長的裂縫，大雨時會有水流過。他相信二十年後，河邊這片土地會再度林木茂密。

questions.questionZh: 樹皮受損時，樹會怎麼樣？
options: 吸引更多昆蟲來吃樹皮

questions.questionZh: 為什麼沒有看到水獺本身？
options: 導覽員要大家保持安靜
河水太深所以看不清楚

items.promptZh: 春天時，農夫把幼苗種在田裡。
referenceEn: In spring, farmers plant seedlings in the fields.
Farmers put the seedlings in the fields in spring.
rubricZh: seedling 是可數名詞，表示「幼苗」（例如 seedlings、tomato seedlings 等）
時態配合內容（例如 plant、planted 等）

items.promptZh: 這座城市在十九世紀達到繁榮的頂點。
referenceEn: The city reached the pinnacle of its success in the nineteenth century.
In the nineteenth century, the city was at the pinnacle of its wealth.
rubricZh: 「頂點」用 pinnacle（例如 the pinnacle of its success 等）
說的是過去的事，用過去式（例如 reached、was 等）
